title: Shared project foundation
description: The source requires a CLI, API, and SQLite persistence but does not prescribe module ownership. Use a small shared application structure with route handlers calling services and services using only the generated persistence package.

options.label: Shared application, service, and persistence boundaries
Keep persistence and behavior inside command handlers

title: Indexes derived from the persistence declaration
description: The rendered schema indexes rates(date). Each is implied by the declaration — a foreign key is looked up by its child column, and a read pattern's Input fields are the predicate it filters on. Declare an `- INDEX (...)` bullet in DATABASE.md for any index this does not cover.
